What Professional Management Looks Like

Lake Keowee is one of the Southeast's most in-demand short-term rental markets — and most owners are leaving significant revenue on the table. We manage every detail so you don't have to.

  • AI-powered dynamic pricing — daily rate adjustments to maximize peak-season revenue and fill shoulder months
  • Multi-platform listing on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking for maximum visibility
  • 100% keyless entry — no lockboxes, no key pickup, no coordination headaches
  • Professional photography and listing copy that converts browsers into bookings
  • Guest screening, 24/7 communication, and 5-star review management
  • Transparent fee structure — you always know exactly what you're earning
  • Local care team for inspections, maintenance, and on-site response
  • Monthly owner statements with full revenue breakdown

Why Basecamp

Six Things We Do That Change the Outcome

Owner satisfaction is a downstream result of guest satisfaction. We start there — and build everything else around it.

01

Modern Marketing That Actually Converts

Professional photography, SEO-optimized listings, AI-driven pricing updated daily, your own direct-booking site, and multi-channel distribution across Airbnb, VRBO & Google. We know how today's guests find and book Lake Keowee — because we built our marketing around it.

02

Smart Locks. No Lockboxes. No Key Pickup. Ever.

Every home we manage gets keyless entry. Guests receive a unique code before arrival and go straight to your door — no coordination headaches, no hidden keys, no hassle for you.

03

Homes That Generate Five-Star Reviews

We stock your home to a standard guests rave about — quality linens, a fully equipped kitchen, lake gear, games, and the small touches that make people feel cared for, not processed. Your reviews are your pricing power.

04

Transparent Fees & a Real Owner Portal

One simple management fee on booking revenue — we only earn when you do. No hidden cleaning markups, no mystery line items, and a real-time portal where you can see bookings, revenue, and reviews any time.

05

A Local Care & Home-Watch Team

Real people on the ground in the SC Upcountry — for guest issues, dock and shoreline care, maintenance, and regular checks on your home between stays. Not a 1-800 number three states away.

06

We Think Like Asset Owners, Not Booking Agents

With 20+ years of real estate experience, we treat your lake house as an investment to protect, maintain, and grow — never maximizing this season's occupancy at the expense of your home's long-term condition.
